question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant within 140 kilometers along the east direction from Stratton Fire Tower, Stratton, Vermont?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Stratton Fire Tower%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%Vermont%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Stratton%' LIMIT 1 ) AS origin WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, origin.geometry::geography, 140000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
